name: Prince Stainless Steel Whistling Kettle
description: Durable stainless steel whistling kettle with a stay-cool handle and flip-up spout. Built for safe, convenient everyday water boiling.
details: This Prince stainless steel whistling kettle is designed for durable and convenient everyday use in Sri Lankan kitchens. Its built-in whistle alerts you as soon as the water reaches a boil, helping prevent overheating and dry boiling. Featuring a wide opening for easy filling and cleaning, a flip-up spout cover for controlled pouring, and a heat-resistant black handle and lid knob for safe handling, it is ideal for making tea, coffee, or boiling water for daily household needs.
